content.text: {"query":"url parse","group":"dev","total":1,"tools":[{"name":"ics_parse","price":"$0.003","group":"dev","description":"Parse an iCalendar (.ics) feed from a URL (SSRF-safe; Google / Outlook / Apple calendar exports) or inline text into JSON: calendar name and zone, events with start / end in any IANA zone, all-day flag, location, organizer, attendee count, status and recurrence rule in English. Give a from / to window to expand recurring events (RRULE, EXDATE, RDATE, RECURRENCE-ID overrides) into concrete occurrences. Windows time-zone names are mapped to IANA.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string","maxLength":2000,"description":"URL of an .ics feed (or use ics)"},"ics":{"type":"string","maxLength":3000000,"description":"iCalendar text"},"from":{"type":"string","maxLength":40,"description":"Window start (expands recurring events); ISO 8601"},"to":{"type":"string","maxLength":40,"description":"Window end (default from + 30 days)"},"tz":{"type":"string","maxLength":64,"description":"Output IANA zone (default the calendar's zone or UTC)"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":1000,"default":100},"descriptions":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"Include event descriptions (truncated)"}}}}],"howToCall":"call_tool {\"name\": \"<tool>\", \"arguments\": {...}}"}

tools.name: ics_parse
tools.description: Parse an iCalendar (.ics) feed from a URL (SSRF-safe; Google / Outlook / Apple calendar exports) or inline text into JSON: calendar name and zone, events with start / end in any IANA zone, all-day flag, location, organizer, attendee count, status and recurrence rule in English. Give a from / to window to expand recurring events (RRULE, EXDATE, RDATE, RECURRENCE-ID overrides) into concrete occurrences. Windows time-zone names are mapped to IANA.

url.description: URL of an .ics feed (or use ics)

tz.description: Output IANA zone (default the calendar's zone or UTC)
